title: Patient Payment Plan Agreement Terms: Installments Collected at Signing When the First Due Date Is Far Off
content:
**Rule.** When a **Patient Payment Plan** offer's first due date lies far from the signing date, installments are collected together with the down payment: two installments when the first due date is more than 60 days after the signing date, one installment when it is more than 45 but at most 60 days after it, and none otherwise, each installment being the offer's current installment.

| Days from the signing date to the first due date | Installments collected at signing |
|---|---|
| 61 or more | two times the current installment |
| 46 to 60 | the current installment |
| 45 or fewer | none |

**Both sides.** At exactly 60 days one installment is collected and at 61 days two; at exactly 45 days none and at 46 days one.

**Hypothetical.** With a current installment of 85.00 and a first due date 52 days after signing, 85.00 is collected with the down payment; at 70 days, 170.00.
